rationale: Mixed existing-field repair: the wa-hide dismissal regression belongs to the current beta line (#976), but v1.81.0 already has the same icon-field wrapper border and capture Escape interception. Removing its duplicate border and retaining the form when dismissing a nested picker improve the pre-existing stable icon field; stable summary omits the beta-only wa-hide regression.

summary.ru: Убрана двойная рамка выбора иконки; Escape внутри списка оставляет настройки устройства открытыми.
summary.en: Removed the duplicate icon-picker border; Escape inside its list keeps device settings open.
